## History

Skinner was previously married to a man named Crowe, during which time she famously chose true love over marrying a rich man. She later remarried and became Mrs. Amelia Skinner. While filling in on the mail route for her new husband, she picked up [Anne](../character/anne.md) at the [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station, drove her to her boarding house at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), and entertained her with stories about her romantic past while warning her about the local geography.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P1](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0001), [v3 ch.Romance P2](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0002), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P6](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0006), [v3 ch.Romance P7](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0007), [v3 ch.Romance P8](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0008), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--skinner.md)

[Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) ([Anne](../character/anne.md)) is Skinner's cousin through his marriage to Amelia Skinner. She first interacts with the family dynamic when Amelia picks her up from the [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station to take her to her boarding house at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the journey, Amelia shares stories about her marriage to Skinner, framing it as a choice of true love over wealth, while offering [Anne](../character/anne.md) advice and warnings about the local geography.

- Relative of — cousin  <sub>[v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)</sub>
